(2) The defining tenure trap in this sub-area is LEASEHOLD: False Creek South sits on City-held land under prepaid-era 60-year ground leases. Streets, schools and getting around False Creek

items.t: False Creek is the inlet between the downtown peninsula and the south-shore neighbourhoods. False Creek South is located between the Cambie and Burrard Street bridges on the south shore, excluding Granville Island and Sen̓áḵw, as the City states. The False Creek Flats Plan study area runs from Main Street to the west, Prior and Venables Streets to the north, Clark Drive to the east, and Great Northern Way to the south. The City's Coastal Adaptation Plan states False Creek North includes portions of Northeast False Creek, Yaletown and Chinatown, and False Creek South passes through Fairview, Southeast False Creek, Olympic Village and the False Creek Flats along the south shore.

The False Creek South waterfront between the Cambie and Burrard bridges is the leasehold stock excluded in aggregate below. Detached houses are not a False Creek shoreline housing form, though FM-1 houses sit on the Fairview Slopes above the south shore.

Main streets: Pacific Boulevard and Expo Boulevard on the north shore; West 2nd Avenue and West 6th Avenue on the south shore; Terminal Avenue and Great Northern Way at the east end; the Burrard Street, Granville Street and Cambie Street bridges cross the water. The Northeast False Creek area is bisected by the Georgia and Dunsmuir viaducts.

Transit anchors: TransLink route 50 (Waterfront Station / False Creek South) runs from Waterfront Station via Chinatown, Granville Island and the False Creek south shore to Olympic Village Station (Canada Line), with buses continuing as route 15. Charleson Park, 999 Charleson Street, sits on the south shore seawall, and the False Creek seawall runs on both shores.

In March 2024 Council directed staff to report back with an updated and enhanced False Creek South development framework addressing current housing pressures, and in summer 2025 the City conducted technical investigations in the neighbourhood to support a future planning process. Leasehold pricing, lender appetite and remaining term are building-specific and UNVERIFIED for any individual building.

: the lands around False Creek are inside the City's designated floodplain system; the City's False Creek Coastal Adaptation Plan covers the floodplain area encompassing False Creek North, False Creek South, Granville Island and the Flats, and parcels in the floodplain are subject to the Vancouver Building By-law Floodplain Standards and Requirements for shoreline setbacks and flood construction levels. The Northeast False Creek Plan requires new developments to be built to protect homes and critical infrastructure from flooding and rising sea levels, with a continuous line of flood protection across that site. The flood construction level for a specific building is a core due-diligence item on both shores; whether a specific parcel is in the floodplain: UNVERIFIED.

blocks.text: Good to know about False Creek

items.t: False Creek South has had no new housing since the 1980s — on purpose-built leasehold land.

The Olympic Village buildings were athletes' housing first. The Southeast False Creek site was the Vancouver Olympic Village for the 2010 Winter Games — the buildings were turned over to VANOC on November 1, 2009 and returned to the City on March 31, 2010, after which they provided approximately 1,000 residential units including 250 affordable housing units, a community centre, daycare and retail space. That history is why market condos and non-market housing sit inside one development under one name.

A new St. Paul's Hospital is planned at the east end. The new St. Paul's Hospital campus is planned at Station Street in the False Creek Flats — the current hospital, at 1081 Burrard Street, is across the inlet in Downtown, and Vancouver General Hospital, 899 West 12th Avenue, sits south of the south shore in Fairview. Neither existing hospital is on a False Creek shoreline.

The viaducts are planned to come down. The Northeast False Creek Plan proposes replacing the Georgia and Dunsmuir viaducts — which currently bisect the north-east shore area — with an at-grade street network, alongside new parks, plazas and a cultural centre; north-shore buildings near Expo and Pacific Boulevards price against that plan, not just the current road pattern.
One shore's school is not the other shore's school.

False Creek was an industrial centre first. The City's Coastal Adaptation Plan states False Creek was historically one of Vancouver's major industrial centres and has transitioned into an area of higher-density housing, commercial areas and parks — the reason the shoreline stock is almost entirely strata form built in planned phases (1970s–80s leasehold south, 2010 Olympic Village south-east, CD-1 towers north), with no detached shoreline stock at all.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in False Creek

items.t: Tenure first, Form B second: On a freehold strata purchase (the Southeast False Creek form), the strata must provide a Form B Information Certificate under Strata Property Act s. 59 — monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. On a False Creek South purchase the Form B is not the first document — the ground lease is: freehold strata versus City-ground-lease leasehold versus co-op shares is the fork the whole purchase turns on, and no Form B cures a short remaining lease term.

Rental-restriction bylaws are VOID — with a tenure boundary: since Nov 24, 2022, no BC strata residential rental-restriction bylaw is valid; short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw, and in Vancouver short-term rentals are separately regulated by the City's own licensing. Any directory "rentals not allowed" line is VOID for long-term rentals. The boundary of this rule: it governs strata bylaws on strata lots — it does not cure a False Creek South ground lease or a co-op's occupancy rules, whose terms are separate documents; the Lamey's Mill listing's "pets & rentals permitted w/ restrictions" line must be read against that building's lease, not against the strata rule alone.

Land tenure — False Creek South framework: the City holds title to 80 acres in False Creek South, leased under 60-year ground leases with most expiring in the next 15 to 25 years. In March 2024 Council directed staff to report back with an updated and enhanced False Creek South development framework addressing current housing pressures, and in summer 2025 the City conducted technical investigations in the neighbourhood to support a future planning process. Leasehold pricing, lender appetite and remaining term are building-specific and UNVERIFIED for any individual building.

Presales (REDMA), where a False Creek presale is bought: the buyer must receive the developer's disclosure statement (REDMA s. 18) and has a 7-day rescission period from the later of signing or acknowledging it (REDMA s. 21), with deposits in trust. No verified current False Creek presale is carried in, so this is the standing frame only.

The Olympic Village buildings were athletes' housing first.

One shore's school is not the other shore's school. Crosstown and Elsie Roy elementaries serve the north shore side and False Creek Elementary the south shore side, and catchments are address-based and differ by shore — a listing that borrows the wrong shore's school is wrong even though both are "False Creek."

City leasehold

items.t: False Creek South ground leases — corrected position, from the City's own page: the City holds title to 80 acres of land in False Creek South; when the neighbourhood was built in the 1970s and 1980s, much of the City land was leased to tenants via 60-year ground leases, with most of the leases expiring in the next 15 to 25 years, and no new housing has been built in False Creek South since the 1980s. Current listings show 2040/2050 terms, consistent with that window. The lease terms and end date for a specific building: UNVERIFIED — they must be read off that building's own lease documents.

Co-operative ground on the same City tenure: Creekview Housing Co-operative's City ground lease expired December 31, 2023 and is in overholding, per the October 7, 2025 Council report — documented as tenure context for the False Creek South leasehold/co-op ground, never as for-sale stock and never as fee-simple.

items.t: False Creek South is located between the Cambie and Burrard Street bridges on the south shore, excluding Granville Island and Sen̓áḵw, as the City states. The False Creek Flats Plan study area runs from Main Street to the west, Prior and Venables Streets to the north, Clark Drive to the east, and Great Northern Way to the south.

Nearby areas: Downtown and the West End across the north shore, Fairview along the south shore, Mount Pleasant at the south-east, Strathcona at the east end, and Kitsilano across the Burrard Street Bridge to the west.

Parks and waterfront: Charleson Park, 999 Charleson Street, sits on the south shore seawall, and the False Creek seawall runs on both shores — the City's Coastal Adaptation Plan describes the area around False Creek as parks used for living, working, recreation and marine activities. Library: a branch located on the False Creek shoreline named on a City or VPL source: UNVERIFIED. Health care: Vancouver General Hospital, 899 West 12th Avenue, south of the south shore in Fairview, and St. Paul's Hospital, 1081 Burrard Street, north of the north shore in Downtown; the new St. Paul's Hospital campus is planned at Station Street in the False Creek Flats. Shopping: Granville Island, on the south shore at the west end, is named by the City as one of Vancouver's attractions inside Fairview; a specific grocery store name and address named on a City source: UNVERIFIED.

Roads and transit: Pacific Boulevard and Expo Boulevard serve the north shore, Terminal Avenue and Great Northern Way serve the east end, and West 2nd Avenue and West 6th Avenue serve the south shore, with the Burrard, Granville and Cambie Street bridges crossing the water; the Northeast False Creek area is bisected by the Georgia and Dunsmuir viaducts. TransLink route 50 (Waterfront Station / False Creek South) runs via Chinatown, Granville Island and the south shore to Olympic Village Station (Canada Line), with buses continuing as route 15. Commute times in minutes: UNVERIFIED.

Schools: SD39 catchments are address-based and differ by shore; SD39 has no middle-school tier — elementary K–7, secondary 8–12. Schools located around the water: Crosstown šxʷwəq̓ʷəθət Elementary, 55 Expo Boulevard, and Elsie Roy Elementary, 150 Drake Street, both listed by VSB under Downtown on the north shore, and False Creek Elementary, 900 School Green, on the south shore in False Creek South; a public secondary school located on either shoreline: UNVERIFIED. School names are as VSB lists them.

Market context: none — Vancouver is outside SnapStats coverage in the FVR + GVR September 2026 reports (coverage is Surrey, S Surrey White Rock, Cloverdale, Langley, North Delta, Abbotsford, Mission, Burnaby, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, New Westminster, Pitt Meadows and Maple Ridge only), and no other stats source is substituted. All market figures for False Creek: UNVERIFIED.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in False Creek

items.t: Zoning — no single district schedule: Southeast False Creek / Olympic Village and False Creek North sit under site-specific CD-1 districts and Official Development Plans (including the False Creek North ODP); FM-1 applies on the Fairview Slopes above the south shore (single detached, duplex, multiple dwellings; maximum FSR 0.60). A specific parcel's zone: UNVERIFIED — read it by part (North, South or Flats), never for "False Creek" as a whole.

Plans as the OCP-equivalent frame here: the Northeast False Creek Plan, the Southeast False Creek development, the False Creek Flats Plan and the pending False Creek South framework (Council direction March 2024) are the plan documents governing this ground — each covers its own part only.

Strata block (for the conventional strata stock; no bare-land strata is verified): Form B diligence (provided within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page); depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022 (short-term restrictions may still apply by bylaw); only 55+ age bylaws valid under SPA ss.123.1/123.2, with May 1, 2023 exemptions; a listing's "45+" line is NOT a valid BC age bylaw. On leasehold strata, the ground lease is read alongside the Form B — remaining term drives financing and pricing.

ALR rules (for completeness — ALR land inside the sub-area: UNVERIFIED in the research): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR.

Vancouver Empty Homes Tax — 3%, VANCOUVER ONLY, applies here: every Vancouver owner must submit an annual property status declaration (due February 3, 2026); the 2025 Empty Homes Tax payment was due April 16, 2026, with a 5% penalty on the unpaid balance after that date. Homes declared or deemed vacant are taxed at 3% of assessed taxable value. Confirm the seller's declaration status on any purchase. The City tax is separate from the provincial Speculation and Vacancy Tax.

items.t: No new housing in False Creek South since the 1980s: the City states the neighbourhood was built in the 1970s and 1980s on its 80 acres and nothing new has been built there since — every False Creek South purchase is a purchase of remaining lease term on 1970s–80s stock.

A hospital is the Flats' anchor project: the new St. Paul's Hospital campus is planned at Station Street in the False Creek Flats — the east end's employment-land plan and its health-care anchor are the same geography.

faq.q: Is False Creek a City of Vancouver local area?
faq.a: No — the City's 22 local areas treat it in parts: False Creek North inside Downtown, False Creek South inside Fairview, and the False Creek Flats at the east end in Strathcona; "False Creek" is the Paragon sub-area name spanning all three.

faq.q: Where exactly is False Creek South, and what is the land tenure there?
faq.a: Between the Cambie and Burrard Street bridges on the south shore, excluding Granville Island and Sen̓áḵw; the City holds title to 80 acres there and most homes sit on 60-year ground leases expiring in the next 15 to 25 years.

faq.q: Which schools are located around False Creek?
faq.a: Crosstown šxʷwəq̓ʷəθət Elementary, 55 Expo Boulevard, and Elsie Roy Elementary, 150 Drake Street, on the north shore, and False Creek Elementary, 900 School Green, on the south shore; no shoreline secondary school was confirmed, and catchments are address-based and differ by shore — check the exact address in the VSB locator.

faq.q: Is flooding a real factor for False Creek homes?
faq.a: Yes — the False Creek area is inside the City's designated floodplain system, the Coastal Adaptation Plan covers the False Creek floodplain (North, South, Granville Island and the Flats), and parcels in the floodplain carry Building By-law setback and flood construction level requirements; a specific parcel's status must be checked in the City dataset.

faq.q: What transit serves the south shore and Granville Island?
faq.a: TransLink route 50 runs from Waterfront Station via Chinatown, Granville Island and the False Creek south shore to Olympic Village Station on the Canada Line, with buses continuing as route 15.

faq.q: Is "False Creek" a real City neighbourhood?
faq.a: No — the City's 22 local areas treat it in parts: False Creek North inside Downtown, False Creek South inside Fairview, and the False Creek Flats at the east end in Strathcona.

faq.q: Is a False Creek South condo freehold?
faq.a: Generally no — that is the trap. The City holds title to 80 acres in False Creek South and most homes sit on 60-year ground leases expiring in the next 15 to 25 years. The counted buildings in are the Southeast False Creek / Olympic Village strata stock, not the False Creek South leasehold stock, which is excluded in aggregate. For any specific south-shore building west of Cambie, read its own lease documents before anything else — its terms are UNVERIFIED until then.

faq.q: What is the Village on False Creek, and is all of it condos?
faq.a: It is the Olympic Village development: a 7-city-block, 16-residential-building mixed-use development built for the 2010 Winter Games. The market strata components verified by name are Kayak (185 units), Brook (129), Bridge (119), Sails (114), Compass (63) and Shoreline (35), all built 2010. The development also holds roughly 250 affordable housing units of its roughly 1,000 residential units — that non-market stock is not for sale as condos and is excluded from the counts.

faq.q: Can I rent out a False Creek condo long-term?
faq.a: In a freehold strata, yes — rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since November 24, 2022. Short-term rentals are separate: a strata can still restrict them and Vancouver licences them. In False Creek South the answer runs through the ground lease first, not the strata bylaws.

faq.q: Is flooding a real factor here?
faq.a: Yes — the whole False Creek area sits inside the City's designated floodplain system under the Coastal Adaptation Plan (North, South, Granville Island and the Flats), and parcels in it carry Building By-law setback and flood construction level requirements. Confirm the specific building's flood construction level and the strata's insurance position in due diligence.

faq.q: Are there any freehold townhouse complexes around False Creek?
faq.a: None verified as standalone freehold complexes.

faq.q: Is a False Creek South townhouse freehold?
faq.a: Generally no — that is the trap. The City holds title to 80 acres in False Creek South and most homes sit on 60-year ground leases expiring in the next 15 to 25 years; the documented Lamey's Mill Road townhouse listing states its own terms plainly — lease to 2040, option to extend to 2060. For any specific south-shore building west of Cambie, read its own lease documents before anything else — its terms are UNVERIFIED until then.

faq.q: What about the co-op on Lamey's Mill Road — can I buy in?
faq.a: Creekview Housing Co-operative, 1483 Lamey's Mill Road, is a housing co-operative on City land: its ground lease dated April 24, 1984 expired December 31, 2023, it has been in overholding since, and a September 26, 2025 Council report sought authority for a below-market overholding agreement while False Creek South redevelopment planning continues.
